_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDER ONLY -- not real captured data from any actual veterinary practice. No real vet-hospital server data was available when this was written. Copy this file to config/software_versions.json and replace every entry with the real software actually running on the target server before relying on it.

practice_management_system._note: e.g. Cornerstone, Avimark, ezyVet, Instinct -- replace check_command with whatever that vendor's CLI/registry/file version stamp actually is on the real box

imaging_dicom_viewer._note: e.g. a PACS/DICOM viewer for digital radiography -- version drift here matters for both bugfixes and modality compatibility

backup_agent._note: whatever performs the server's nightly backup -- staleness here is a genuinely high-stakes maintenance signal

os_patch_level._note: e.g. `wmic qfe list` on Windows Server, or a distro's patch-date stamp on Linux -- track as a single rollup string if the real check is too noisy to diff line-by-line
